purpose: Equalize a fixed set of weather masks across retrained LightGBM, TabM and empirical adapter
status: Exploratory analysis after all 2022-2026Q3 results were inspected; no new confirmatory holdout
2021: report only, not a model search
views: One fixed mask per training origin, shared across all models and neural seeds; not dynamic augmentation per epoch
tabular_features: 161 original causal features plus 4 full-history and 4 last24 weather availability fractions. LightGBM native NaNs and available-only summaries. TabM training-mean imputes feature NaNs and gets the same 8 availability fractions.
models: Original architectures and optimizer budgets. LightGBM 600 trees/patience40. TabM60 epochs/patience8, global checkpoint only. Adapter30/patience5. No test-driven changes.
evaluation_masks: Reuse the exact saved masks from reviewer follow-up, seed777

pre_evaluation_amendments.reason: A mean-imputed tabular feature may equal a valid mean observation. Add explicit NaN indicators for every weather feature that is missing in training so the TabM baseline can distinguish these cases, as the adapter can.
pre_evaluation_amendments.feature_rule: Append one binary indicator per original numeric column with any training NaN; training-only determination, then freeze columns. Keep the original summary-availability TabM as an additional prespecified control.
pre_evaluation_amendments.hyperparameters: Unchanged except input dimension implied by the additional indicators; max60epochs/patience8,2020complete early stopping.
